title: Operations Data Analyst
description:
Job Title: Operations Data Analyst
Location: Chester Business Park, Chester
Contract Type: 12 Months (Fully on-site for training, then hybrid)


Our client, a prominent financial institution, is seeking an Operations Data Analyst to join their Global Markets Operations Reporting & Analytics team. This is an exciting opportunity for a data-driven professional to leverage analytics and automation to enhance operational efficiency and strengthen risk controls.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards that provide actionable insights into operational performance, efficiency, and risk.
  • Develop and support Alteryx workflows to automate reporting, data preparation, and operational processes.
  • Create KPI reporting and management information for operational teams and senior leadership.
  • Support data sourcing, quality, and governance initiatives to improve the accuracy and reliability of reporting.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Global Markets Operations to translate business challenges into reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through data analysis and process automation.
  • Manage multiple reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives simultaneously, taking ownership from requirements gathering through implementation and ongoing support.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience in developing dashboards and visualisations using Tableau.
  • Experience in building automated workflows using Alteryx or the ability to quickly adapt to new analytics and automation tools.
  • Proficient SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
  • Proven experience in using data analytics to identify business insights, drive operational improvement, and support decision-making.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience in gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Experience:

    • Experience within Financial Services, Financial Markets, or Operations environments.


This is an exceptional chance to make a significant impact within a dynamic team, delivering measurable business value through innovative analytics and automation solutions. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to showcase their expertise and contribute to the success of our client's operational goals.

If you are passionate about data analytics and automation, and you thrive in a collaborative environment, this role offers the perfect platform to grow your career.

Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity to be part of a leading financial institution. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey where your skills will be valued and your contributions recognised!

How to Apply:
Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their CV along with a cover letter detailing relevant experience and skills.

Take the next step in your career with this fantastic opportunity to work with our client in Chester!
